profile: Hosted owner consent and explicit provider review with application-supplied records
runtimeStatus: stopped; private authority state and encrypted backup retained
topology: Single Fly Machine with encrypted persistent volume and HTTPS ingress

cases.evidence: Record source, required fields, read-only application permissions and six secret references; no vendor key.
Liveness 200, readiness 503 and authenticated submission 503; zero accounts before activation.

cases.method: Auth0 login and GUI token controls
cases.evidence: Real owner/staff logins and dedicated-audience RFC 9068 application tokens, with 600-second lifetime.
Admitted application received the required fields and evaluation-only source.
Complete record submitted; incomplete record invalid; only one new consent request.
Owner consent alone left provider review pending and provisioning denied; independent staff acceptance granted access.
One real CDP wallet provisioned; account reads identified application_record and evaluation_only.
Original provisioning key returned the same account/address.
Concurrent original-key requests returned the same wallet.
Server-held application credentials read the granted account.
Missing authorization returned 401.

cases.method: Auth0 grant editor and application HTTP client
cases.evidence: A genuinely reduced client grant issued a signed token without account-read scope; API returned 403 insufficient_scope.
A different full-scope client could not read the account or access request.
Concurrent batch replay retained the original request; a changed required field under the same key returned 409.

cases.method: Host maintenance and supplied doctor CLI
cases.evidence: All dispatchers stopped; AES-GCM backup restored into the same binding with no backup gap and one authoritative process. Catalog/integrity checks and original replay passed.
Live CDP lookup found the original wallet and restored its receipt. This was a known successful outcome, not a lost-provider-response exercise.

cases.method: Owner GUI and application HTTP client
cases.evidence: Suspension denied account reads and original provisioning replay.

cases.method: Application HTTP, owner consent and reviewer GUI
cases.evidence: Fresh consent and review were required; accepted reconnection retained the wallet.
Another authenticated test owner was denied access to the bound request.

cases.method: Owner GUI and application HTTP client
cases.evidence: Revocation denied reads and original provisioning replay.

cases.method: FormKit export, CLI deployment and application HTTP
cases.evidence: Changing the policy version marked old access policy_changed and denied reads/replay; a fresh reviewed grant used the new policy.
Transfer permission in the record profile was rejected with 422 before provider effects.
Chain ID verified and native balance zero before and after recovery and policy tests.
Final current-policy grant expires at 2026-10-17T12:06:35.637Z; no simulated clock or database expiry edit used.
No reviewed mechanism discarded a provider response after dispatch in this configured deployment. Client retries and known-result lookup do not establish this case.
Planned maintenance/restore does not establish abrupt power-loss or crash-during-commit behavior.

limits: Fictional test records and dedicated staging users; no real customer identity data.
Didit/Sumsub and financial signing were not selected or accepted by this exercise.
Later application-led profiles require a separate deployment test.
No claim of production custody approval, vendor certification or completed full deployment acceptance.
